name: tabular_xgb_optuna_bad
title: A 200-trial Optuna sweep over XGBoost's native DMatrix API, with every trial early-stopping on the test set and the objective returning the test AUC
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-tabular: the hyperparameter-search-on-the-holdout defect

expected.defect: the quantile transform is fitted on the whole feature matrix two lines before the split
expected.why: every quantile boundary the model trains against was computed with the held-out rows in it, so the training features already know the shape of the test distribution

expected.defect: accuracy_score is handed the probability column from predict_proba(...)[:, 1] instead of a decision
expected.why: a continuous vector is compared to 0/1 labels, so the reported accuracy is roughly the chance rate however good the model is

expected.defect: roc_auc_score is handed final.predict(...), a hard 0/1 label
expected.why: the ROC curve then has two points, so the headline number is balanced accuracy wearing an AUC label
the split moves every run, so the 200-trial search is not reproducible and neither is the number it reports

expected.defect: nothing seeds random or numpy, the Optuna sampler carries no seed and neither booster carries a random_state
expected.why: the search explores a different region of the space on every run, so two runs of this file disagree about the best hyperparameters as well as about the score

forbidden.why: no transformer is fitted on test_x: the quantile transform was fitted on the whole matrix before the split existed, which is MLV101's defect, and re-blaming it as MLV102 would be two findings for one root cause
the credit table has no timestamp: nothing parses a date, converts one or sorts by one
there is no torch in this project and no hand-written gradient step
model.eval() is a torch idiom with no xgboost equivalent
torch.no_grad() has no meaning in an xgboost program
no device is ever named in this project
nothing is pickled or loaded here

notes: The worst two defects in this file are both unsupported. (1) Every trial's evals watch-list is the test DMatrix and every trial stops early on it (line 66-69), and the objective returns the test AUC (line 71), so two hundred trials of model selection are run against the data the final number is reported from - that is MLV107, catalogued but not implemented. (2) xgb.cv at line 77 runs five folds over `features`, which prepare() had already quantile-transformed outside any fold; MLV103 does not see it because xgb.cv is not a scikit-learn CV call and the functional boosting API carries the GBM_TRAIN role rather than FIT.

optuna is not in any knowledge table, and the analyzer says so: one unresolved_callee diagnostic names create_study at line 89. The search loop is therefore invisible as a loop, which is the honest consequence and is recorded rather than labelled.
